docs.summary: This study will evaluate the safety of inavolisib in combination with fulvestrant, with or without palbociclib, in participants with PIK3CA-mutated, HR+, HER2-negative ABC and type 2 diabetes.

docs.summary:

docs.title: A Study to Test Whether Survodutide Helps People With Type 2 Diabetes Control Their Blood Sugar
docs.summary:
This study aims to find out whether a study medicine called survodutide helps people control their blood sugar. Adults who live with type 2 diabetes and with a body mass index (BMI) of 23 kg/m2 or higher can join.

The study has 3 parts. In each part the study compares survodutide with placebo. Survodutide is being developed to treat several health problems including type 2 diabetes. Placebo looks like survodutide but does not contain any medicine.

Depending on a person's diabetes treatment, a person will be assigned either to

* Part B: diabetes

docs.title: AV-1959R Vaccine in Individuals With Preclinical Alzheimer's Disease
docs.summary: This Phase 2 study will evaluate the safety, tolerability, immunogenicity, and amyloid-lowering effect of AV-1959R in cognitively unimpaired adults with preclinical Alzheimer's disease. Approximately 160 participants will be randomized to receive AV-1959R or placebo and will be followed for 78 weeks. The study will assess safety, immune responses, brain amyloid, and Alzheimer's disease-related biomarkers.

Eligible patients having bariatric surgery will be randomly assigned to one of the two treatment groups. Patients and study teams will not know which treatment each participant receives. Participants will be grouped based on whether they have obstructive sleep apnea (OSA).

docs.title: PROACT AYA: Preventing Overweight/Obesity-Associated Cardiotoxicity With Tirzepatide In Adolescent And Young Adult Cancer Survivors - A Phase 2 Single-Arm, Single-Center Feasibility Study
docs.summary: This is a prospective, single-arm, open-label feasibility trial conducted at the MD Anderson Sarcoma Center and Cardio-Oncology Clinic. The study will enroll young adults (18-39 years) with soft tissue or bone sarcoma who are overweight (BMI 25-29.9 kg/m² with ≥1 cardiovascular risk factor) or obese (BMI ≥30 kg/m²), have completed Dox-based chemotherapy (≥300 mg/m²) approximately three months prior to enrollment, and have preserved LVEF (≥50%) preenrollment.

docs.title: A Study of EloraTZP in Adult Participants With Obesity Without Type 2 Diabetes
docs.summary:
The purpose of this study is to investigate the efficacy and safety of eloralintide and tirzepatide coformulation (EloraTZP) compared with tirzepatide, eloralintide and placebo for body weight reduction in participants with obesity.

Participation in the study will last about 2 years.

docs.title: A Study of EloraTZP in Adult Participants With Obesity or Overweight and Type 2 Diabetes
docs.summary:
The purpose of this study is to investigate the efficacy and safety of eloralintide and tirzepatide coformulation (EloraTZP) compared to tirzepatide for body weight reduction in participants with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes.

Participation in the study will last about 2 years.

docs.title: Becotatug Vedotin + Pucotenlimab+Platinum Induction and Sequential CCRT for Unresectable LA NSCLC
docs.summary: This is a prospective, single-arm phase II clinical study enrolling patients with locally advanced unresectable non-small cell lung cancer. All enrolled patients receive induction therapy with Becotatug Vedotin combined with pucotenlimab and platinum-based regimens. Patients who complete the scheduled induction treatment will subsequently receive definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy.

docs.summary: The primary objective of this pilot study is to evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of a clinical trial protocol investigating 10 mg/day empagliflozin in breast cancer patients receiving anthracycline-based chemotherapy.
